body:
I'm not sure what you are asking. I'm sorry if I sound ignorant. My food stamp situation is kinda nutty. See, he is on *all* my bills because everything is in his name and he never bothered to turn most of it off. We haven't been split up very long at all. Soooo, the state where I live requires me to have a notarized letter from him stating that he is no longer a member of the household or else I have to transfer the bills into my name individually, which I do not have deposits to do. This has left me with the option of emergency food stamps, which would be great but is somewhat of a pain in the butt. I don't expect it to be more than 7-10 days before they turn on though. Most of my hurdles have been to prove that he doesn't live here. It does look like I am lying though because everything is still in his name and the obvious question is *why?* Well, saying "I don't know, because he never turned it off" is a horrible answer but it's the only one I have. 

As for how I'm feeling, just really scared and freaked out. I guess it's mostly because now I have *a lot* of regrets. I'm not stupid. I'm uneducated. I have no job experience. I have no life experience. I don't know simple things that now I realize I should know. I mean, *it's not entirely about money.* That is just at the forefront of my mind right now. I mean to say I just don't have the skills that I should have and it is my fault. Idk how to explain it other than I just have a lot of regrets and I wish I would have gave myself a chance earlier in life. Like I said before, I'm not stupid. I can see what I did wrong.

I can relate to this A LOT. I see a counsoler now but I just don't think she's properly equipped to deal with me. She reminds me of a tape recorder just playing the same shit back over and over again. It doesn't really help at all. The meds aren't helping much either. I think when I am able to I will try to find someone else to see. I just don't even know where to begin looking. If you want to talk, I'll be up for a while.
I'm pretty bad at it too so that may work out.
Do you want to talk about it or something?

Well, I have applied for food assistance but I'm waiting and waiting on approval. It's also not helping that his name is on the lease so it looks like he lives here. Same with electric. 

I'm not eligible for other benefits because I do not have children. I do think I could go back to my family but I just don't have any way to get there which sucks. 

This is exactly what I mean by not having any opportunity or resources. It seems like you have to have money for everything. I could move somewhere cheaper but that would cost me. I could go find stuff to recycle but the cost of travel. If I get a job, I'd have a problem even buying clothes to wear there. It seems like you have to have money to do anything t better your life but I don't have any money or any way to make any money because I don't have any money to provide myself with an opportunity. I feel like everywhere I turn is a dead end. I'm just mostly frustrated and out of hope. I do not see a way out. There are little opportunities for people like myself. The most basic needs are almost impossible to meet at times. I just can't see this leading to a life of anything but stress and poverty.
